segments.text: sattandra, in absolutely independent grace of Lord Shiva, his state of Sathandra, his state
of perfect independence shines again. Then what happens to him? Be the Tiraskare, Sargantar
Karmatam. He drives away all the field of different differentiated perceptions. Be the
Tiraskare, based differentiated perceptions. When these differentiated perceptions are kept away
or subsided, then Sargantar Karmatam. He enters another creation of God consciousness.
New world. He enters in New world. Shri Ruprana, the Anta, Adivana, Athana, Sakal, Pralya,
Kalah, the Pramatri, Ujita, Sya, Vedasya, that differentiated perception which is concerned with
that subject to being, that individual who is not away from Sakala or Pralpralya, who is
residing in Sakala state and Pralya state. Because he has ego on Shri Ruprana, Purastra
can shun. Not ego in his own real nature of God consciousness. He is away from that state.
When that differentiated perception is kept away. When he drives away this differentiated perception
from himself, Tiraskare. Tiraskare means he does not ignore it totally. He ignores it through mind.
Although he does everything as other individuals do. But internally he is not attached to those
differentiated perceptions. That is what he explains. Tiraskare, Thithasya, although he is in them,
although he lives in these differentiated perceptions. But Chitgarh Nusava, Unma, Janahat,
nature of his God consciousness shines forth and apahastani. He subsides that differentiated perception
by that. And successfully he enters in the world of Mantra Pramata, Mantrasya Pramata, Mantrasya Pramata.
Shudvidya, Isher and Sadashiva. Successfully and attains glory of his own.
So Mahatma, Avavta, when he attains this Samatma, his own glory, his own real glory of God consciousness,
then Sargantar Karmatam takes place. Then he enters another new world of God consciousness. He ignores that
previous degraded individual consciousness. Yathabi, Lashita, Nirmaya, Nirmatrit, Nambavati. Whatever he thinks,
whatever he tries to desire, it comes true to him afterwards. Thathajya, she is such a Chandi. It is
already quoted in Sachanda Tantra. When you put awareness, not only in two but in three.
Triple awareness carries one to God consciousness and becomes one with Sachanda. Triple awareness.
There must be triple awareness, not two awarenesses of inhaling and exhaling. There must be triple.
Inhale, exhale and junction. One step, another step and in between. One talk, another talk and
in between, another sensation of talk in the center. When you are aware of these three centers,
then you are carried to Sachanda by Lord God consciousness. So in this Shloka, in Sachanda Shloka,
Sachanda Sadrasheena, Vedittiraskaram, as he becomes one with Sachanda. When one with Bhairavanatha,
so differentiated perception do not exist for him. Then another quoting, the same Tantra.
Brahma, Vishni, Indra, Devana, Siddha, Dai, Thore, Gesh, Shrinam, Bhairata, Chharta, Chha, Shapa, Nugra,
Krasbha, Darpam, Harati, Kalesya, Pati, Bhudara, he becomes so great that he terrifies Brahma, Vishnu,
Indra. Brahma, Vishnu, Indra, all these topmost devatas are afraid from his wrath.
Siddha, Dai, Thoregationam, Siddhas, Daityas and those who are who rule on all great,
those who are Gharada etc. All these great Daitis. By that he puts fear in them or drives away
fear from them, if he is satisfied with them. Shapa, Nugra, Krasbha, he becomes the bestover of
Boons and Shapa. What is Shapa? Kurs, Kurs. He kurses and gives Boons also. Darpam, Harati,
Kalesya. Even the Lord of time, Mahakala, Lord of death does not stand before him. Darpam,
Harati, Kalesya, Pati, Bhudara, Pati, Pati, Jirav, Throne down, he throws down great mountains also
to the ground level by his power of will.
